result:
I've planned round 402: **PERF-14b-ii, clip virtualization in the lane** (stage 3 of 4 of PERF-14). The lane will draw only the clips near the visible window. The same round also re-checks one small fix of mine from round 401. Decision is **CONTINUE**. No app source changed during my phase (`store/` shows 0 changed files) and the baseline stays `c17d0e9`, because gate 401 was skipped.

**Round 401 result.** C passed 11 of 12 rows, with browser checks done. The one failure, C-R401-01 (Low), was my mistake: line 3 of `lessons.md` still pointed to the old retro. I fixed it in this planning, and only that line changed. RETRO 401 counts as done once C passes the RT-FIX-401 row in round 402.

**Fixes made before dispatch.** All of this was done in a scratch copy outside `store/`, since deleted.
- **TL-R398-SK-M1 (Medium):** a window blur now releases a held clip, and all three window listeners are removed.
- **TL-R398-SK-L1:** releases also happen when the lane unmounts.
- **New tests:** VZ8–VZ10. 11 deliberately broken versions of the code all made the tests fail.
- **Interactions spec:** three of the four round-400 spec Lows are fixed. Low 3 is kept by ruling and moved to `deferred_low_polish`.
- **Budgets:** the zoom path-rewrites count goes from 3 to 2, because a clip scrolled into view is now mounted fresh instead of redrawn. Six scale rows become hard limits, and scrolling gets a ceiling of ≤ 140 components per step.
- **Group drag ruling (Q-14B-PIN-GROUP-MEMBERS):** clips moved together in the same lane are not kept mounted. The harness check (f) can fail again if that changes.

**Evidence on the exact patch A will apply:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Full vitest | 261 files, 3,862 tests pass |
| Typecheck, Biome | rc 0 |
| Scale perf spec | page 950 / 1532 / 1868 elements (≤ 2000), 200 clips, 42.4 components per zoom key, 116.5 per scroll step; all limits pass |
| Interactions, resources, `studio-lab` perf specs | rc 0 |
| Browser probe, both viewports | a held clip stays mounted while scrolling; after blur it unmounts; an off-screen group member appears at its moved position during the drag; Undo restores it |
| 200-clip frame probe, both viewports | 0 frames with a blank gap, out of about 450 |
| `tech-lead` review | first pass found 3 Medium and 4 Low in my sketch, all handled; the second pass on the final patch found no new Medium or higher |

The advisor was used before planning and before finishing.

**What A and C do:**
- **A** applies `b-round-401/sketch-402.patch.txt` exactly as written, writes doc 256 and updates the relevant sections of docs 254 and 255.
- **C** first runs the browser rows: auth guard, the frame probe, the pin/blur/group probe and a short Studio smoke, at both viewports. Then the perf specs, one at a time, followed by test, budget, doc and RT-FIX checks.

Export is not re-checked in this round. I added it to REGRESSION-2026-11-10, which falls due at the first planning on or after 2026-11-10. After that: PERF-14c, then the rest of the existing order.

No frontend-architect checkpoint is requested yet; I'll ask root for one at the end of PERF-14 if 14c also lands in `ArrangementLane.tsx`.

Everything is in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`: `current-task.md`, `tasks/round-401.md` (copy of the previous task), `b-round-401.md`, `b-next.json`, `backlog.json` (v370), `feature-status.md` and `lessons.md`. Supporting runs, logs and the review are in `b-round-401/`.
